title: Gramine improves sepsis-induced myocardial dysfunction by binding to NF-kappaB p105 and inhibiting its ubiquitination.
authors: Dao, Ling; Liu, Hengdao; Xiu, Ruizhen; Yao, Tianbao; Tong, Renyang; Xu, Longwei
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦竹碱通过分子对接结合NF-κB p105并抑制其泛素化改善脓毒症心肌功能障碍，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白/小分子互作而非TF-DNA体系，且方法仅含简单分子对接，与课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis and its associated heart failure are among the leading causes of death. Gramine, a natural indole alkaloid, can be extracted from a wide variety of raw plants, and it exhibits therapeutic potential in pathological cardiac hypertrophy. However, the effect of gramine on inflammatory cardiomyopathy, particularly sepsis-induced myocardial injury, remains an unexplored area. PURPOSE: To determine the role of gramine in sepsis-induced myocardial dysfunction and explore its underlying mechanism. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: In mice, sepsis was established by intraperitoneally injecting lipopolysaccharide (LPS, 10 mg/kg). Subsequently, the effects of gramine administration (50 or 100 mg/kg) on LPS-triggered cardiac dysfunction in mice were investigated. For in vitro studies, isolated primary cardiomyocytes were used to assess the effect of gramine (25 or 50 microM) on LPS-induced apoptosis and inflammation. Additionally, molecular docking, co-immunoprecipitation and ubiquitination analyzes were conducted to explore the underlying mechanisms. RESULTS: Gramine visibly ameliorated sepsis-induced cardiac dysfunction, inflammatory response, and mortality in vivo. Moreover, it significantly alleviated LPS-induced apoptotic and inflammatory responses in vitro. Furthermore, target prediction for gramine using the SuperPred website indicated that the nuclear factor NF-kappaB p105 subunit was one of the molecules ranked in priority order with a high model accuracy and a high probability score. Molecular docking studies demonstrated that gramine effectively docked to the death domain of NF-kappaB p105. Mechanistic studies revealed that gramine suppressed the processing of NF-kappaB p105 to p50 by inhibiting NF-kappaB p105 ubiquitination. Additionally, the protective effect of gramine on cardiac injury was almost abolished by overexpressing NF-kappaB p105. CONCLUSION: Gramine is a promising bioactive small molecule for treating sepsis-induced myocardial dysfunction, which acts by docking to NF-kappaB p105 and inhibiting NF-kappaB p105 ubiquitination, thus preventing its processing to NF-kappaB p50. Therefore, gramine holds potential as a clinical drug for treating myocardial depression during sepsis.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症及其相关心力衰竭是导致死亡的主要原因之一。芦竹碱（Gramine）是一种天然吲哚生物碱，可从多种原始植物中提取，并在病理性心脏肥大中展现出治疗潜力。然而，芦竹碱对炎症性心肌病，特别是脓毒症诱导的心肌损伤的作用，仍是一个未探索的领域。目的：确定芦竹碱在脓毒症诱导的心肌功能障碍中的作用，并探讨其潜在机制。研究设计与方法：在小鼠中，通过腹腔注射脂多糖（LPS，10 mg/kg）建立脓毒症模型。随后，研究了芦竹碱给药（50或100 mg/kg）对LPS触发的小鼠心脏功能障碍的影响。在体外研究中，使用分离的原代心肌细胞评估芦竹碱（25或50微摩尔）对LPS诱导的细胞凋亡和炎症的影响。此外，进行了分子对接、共免疫沉淀和泛素化分析以探讨潜在机制。结果：芦竹碱在体内明显改善了脓毒症诱导的心脏功能障碍、炎症反应和死亡率。此外，它在体外显著减轻了LPS诱导的凋亡和炎症反应。进一步地，使用SuperPred网站对芦竹碱进行靶点预测表明，核因子NF-kappaB p105亚基是优先排序的分子之一，具有高模型准确性和高概率得分。分子对接研究表明，芦竹碱有效对接至NF-kappaB p105的死亡结构域。机制研究揭示，芦竹碱通过抑制NF-kappaB p105的泛素化来抑制其加工为p50。此外，过表达NF-kappaB p105几乎消除了芦竹碱对心脏损伤的保护作用。结论：芦竹碱是一种有前景的生物活性小分子，用于治疗脓毒症诱导的心肌功能障碍，其作用机制是通过对接至NF-kappaB p105并抑制其泛素化，从而阻止其加工为NF-kappaB p50。因此，芦竹碱具有作为治疗脓毒症期间心肌抑制的临床药物的潜力。
